Main Artist

ATF

ATF is the flagship artist of JuellMusic, delivering raw energy fused with precision-crafted production. Born from the underground, ATF's sound is an electric storm of metallic textures and thunderous bass.

With influences spanning industrial techno, trap, and experimental electronica, each track is a diamond-cut gem — sharp, reflective, and unbreakable. ATF doesn't just make music; ATF forges sonic weapons.

Latest releases have garnered over 2M+ streams across platforms, with placements in major gaming soundtracks and fashion week runways. The future of sound is here.
